id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_170.pack|cs_: "Thank you for waiting, everyone! Finally, the Masked Tourney final!
"These are the two teams that made it!
"Team Vince and {var:1}! Please take the stage!
"The top favorites! Such a confident stride! The air of a true king! Can they defend the championship?!
"Team Rab and Jade! Please take the stage!
"A barely moving old man and a lady with lightning legs! This mysterious duo may become the new champions!
"I'm a fighter myself. I can feel just how strong they are... {var:1}, don't let your guard down.
Vince took out a small bottle and gulped down its contents!
"All right, {var:1}! Win and we're the champions! Let's go all out!
"Now then, let's see what you can do.
